name: Aaryan Gaikwad
player_statement:
A complete player, Aaryan Gaikwad has made a big mark in cricket. With 10 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 60, with an average of 27.29 and a quick strike rate of 88.02. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 3 sixes and 16 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 17.4 overs, taking 5 wickets at an economy rate of 5.77. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
